journey.name: paykit quoted usdt requests
journey.description: Two linked Bitkit wallets with Paykit and USDT enabled, sharing enabled by their owners, and a fresh BTC/USD rate. These request-creation and amount-screen checks need no funds and stop before payment review. Funded Arbitrum review, paid history, controlled rates and proof verification are manual tests in Docs/USDT-QA.md; a Bitcoin regtest balance does not fund USDT.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.

Open a linked contact and create a USD payment request. Verify BTC and USD are the denomination choices and enabled receiving methods start selected. Verify Accept Payment In appears below expiry, with compact outlined Bitcoin and USDT chips. Bitcoin groups all available Savings and Spending methods; no separate rail chips appear here.

On a comma-decimal device locale, enter 3,25 USD while creating a payment request. Verify the keypad, entered amount, request review and recipient row all show exactly 3,25 USD. Go back and verify the amount and denomination are preserved. On iOS with Classic Bitcoin display, repeat with a BTC amount and verify the keypad and amount use a dot and returning from review preserves the amount.
Deselect all receiving choices and verify sending the request is disabled. Select only USDT, enter 1 USD, select an expiry and send the request.

On the payer, open the request. Verify Amount shows exactly $1 with USDT selected as the payment method, the amount cannot be edited, and no Bitcoin funding source is offered. Close without continuing to review.

Reopen the unpaid USDT request and wait for its Amount screen. Tap Back and verify the send sheet closes without showing a Bitcoin confirmation or a Swipe To Pay control. Reopen the same request and verify its amount and USDT payment method are preserved. Close without paying.

Create a BTC request accepting Bitcoin and USDT. On the payer's Amount screen, switch between available Savings, Spending and USDT sources. Verify the displayed amount preserves the request's quoted value and cannot be edited. Close without continuing.

Create a USD subscription. Verify Accepted Payments appears below frequency, with USDT selected and Bitcoin unselected. Verify the description and icon controls are side by side. Propose it to the linked contact. On the payer, review its dollar amount, recurrence and USDT payment method. Verify the subscription swipe uses USDT teal, then close before subscribing.

Create a BTC subscription and verify Bitcoin is selected. Tap SubscriptionAccept-usdt; verify the amount converts to USD and only USDT is selected. Tap SubscriptionAccept-bitcoin; verify the amount converts to BTC and only Bitcoin is selected, covering the enabled Savings and Spending methods. Close without proposing.
Open a linked USDT-only contact that has published a private payment list. Verify the amount screen offers only USDT, enter 0.01, then close without continuing to review.
